CommunityApplications.Profile: Cleanarr gets your storage back without losing what you love. It is rule-based library cleanup for Sonarr and Radarr, driven by what your household actually watches and requests. Rules combine three sources of evidence: your library from Sonarr/Radarr (age, size, ratings, genre, quality, codec, HDR, tags, release group and more), watch history from Plex (last watched, play count, who watched), and requests from Seerr (who asked, and whether the requester has finished watching it). Build rules with ready-made templates or a condition builder using and/or/not, then choose the action per rule: delete, unmonitor, delete files only, or delete a single season. Safe by design: dry run is the default and preview never writes; matches wait in a cancelable queue with a countdown; every item is re-checked against live data right before it is touched; missing or unreachable data means a cleanup rule never fires; protect rules, pinned titles and the "keep" tag always win; a per-run cap limits the blast radius; and an append-only audit trail records what happened and why. Press "Why?" on any title to see each condition and whether it passed. Runs on a schedule or on demand, with a phone-friendly dashboard. One container, one SQLite file, API keys encrypted at rest, no account or cloud service required. amd64 and arm64.
